member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.Abstractions.IDischargeSummaryRepository
member.summary: Defined here (Application) and implemented in Infrastructure, per the dependency inversion rule in docs/Architecture.md — Application never references EF Core types.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.DischargeSummaryErrorCodes
member.summary: Stable, machine-readable error codes for expected DischargeSummary-module failures, per docs/ApiStandards.md §5 — the UI branches on these, not on the message text.

member.name: F:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.DischargeSummaryErrorCodes.InvalidAdmission
member.summary: The referenced Admission does not exist (IAdmissionService.GetByIdAsync returned a failure).

member.name: F:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.DischargeSummaryErrorCodes.AdmissionNotDischarged
member.summary: Create was attempted for an Admission whose Status isn't Discharged yet — see docs/DecisionLog.md's creation-gate decision.

member.name: F:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.DischargeSummaryErrorCodes.AlreadyExists
member.summary: A DischargeSummary already exists for this AdmissionId — one per admission, enforced here (check-then-create) with a unique index as a backstop.

member.name: F:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.DischargeSummaryErrorCodes.InvalidPatient
member.summary: The Admission's own PatientId does not resolve via IPatientService — defense-in-depth (the patient could theoretically be soft-deleted after admission).

member.name: F:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.DischargeSummaryErrorCodes.NotDraft
member.summary: Update was attempted while Status is already Finalized.

member.name: F:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.DischargeSummaryErrorCodes.AlreadyFinalized
member.summary: Finalize was attempted while Status is already Finalized.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.DischargeSummaryService
member.summary: Orchestrates DischargeSummary use cases: expected failures (not found, admission not discharged, duplicate, already finalized) are returned as failures, never thrown — see docs/Architecture.md's exception handling strategy.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.IDischargeSummaryService
member.summary: Public (not internal): DischargeSummariesController — which ASP.NET Core requires to be public, with a public constructor, for controller discovery and DI activation — takes this as a constructor dependency. A public constructor cannot have an internal parameter type (CS0051), so this interface is the module's deliberate, narrow seam between its public HTTP boundary and its otherwise-internal Application/Domain/Infrastructure layers. Mirrors HMS.Modules.IPD.Application.IAdmissionService.

member.name: M:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.IDischargeSummaryService.CreateDraftAsync(System.Guid,System.Nullable{System.Guid},System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Creates a Draft for an already-Discharged admission. Fails with DischargeSummaryErrorCodes.InvalidAdmission if the admission doesn't exist, AdmissionNotDischarged if its Status isn't Discharged yet, or AlreadyExists if one already exists for this AdmissionId.

member.name: M:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.IDischargeSummaryService.UpdateAsync(System.Guid,HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Contracts.UpdateDischargeSummaryRequest,System.Nullable{System.Guid},System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Full-record update of every clinical/examination/vitals/course/surgical/ advice field. Fails with DischargeSummaryErrorCodes.NotDraft once Finalized.

member.name: M:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.IDischargeSummaryService.FinalizeAsync(System.Guid,HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Contracts.FinalizeDischargeSummaryRequest,System.Nullable{System.Guid},System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Transitions Draft → Finalized, stamping FinalizedAt/FinalizedByUserId. Fails with DischargeSummaryErrorCodes.AlreadyFinalized if already Finalized.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.Mapping.DischargeSummaryMappingExtensions
member.summary: Manual entity-to-DTO mapping. A single entity doesn't justify a mapping library (Mapster/AutoMapper) at MVP scale — see docs/DecisionLog.md ADR-003.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.Validators.FinalizeDischargeSummaryRequestValidator
member.summary: Every field on FinalizeDischargeSummaryRequest is optional (docs/DecisionLog.md's sign-off decision), so there are no RuleFor entries today — kept as a real validator class (rather than omitted) so DischargeSummariesController.Finalize follows the same validate-then-call-service shape as every other action, and so a future required field has an obvious place to add its rule.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.Validators.UpdateDischargeSummaryRequestValidator
member.summary: Server-side validation — the authoritative check — mirroring the max lengths enforced by DischargeSummaryConfiguration and simple sanity ranges for the vitals fields. Every field is optional (a doctor fills sections in over time before Finalize), so nothing here uses NotEmpty.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Application.Validators.DischargeMedicationRequestValidator
member.summary: Mirrors DischargeMedicationConfiguration's column max lengths. DrugName/Dose/Route are the only required fields on a line — the four per-time-of-day quantities and DurationDays default to 0 in the DTO if omitted, which is a legitimate (if unusual) line (e.g. a "stop this drug" entry), so they're bounded to non-negative rather than required.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Contracts.DischargeMedicationRequest
member.summary: One discharge medication line, as submitted on Update. The full list is replaced wholesale each time (list-sync, no separate per-line CRUD) — see DischargeSummary.ReplaceMedications.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Contracts.DischargeMedicationResponse
member.summary: One discharge medication line, as returned on Get/Update/Finalize.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Contracts.UpdateDischargeSummaryRequest
member.summary: Full-record update — every clinical/examination/vitals/course/surgical/advice field, submitted together on every PUT (matches the approved plan's MVP scope: no per-field PATCH). Only allowed while Status is Draft; rejected once Finalized (DischargeSummaryErrorCodes.NotDraft).

member.name: P:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Contracts.UpdateDischargeSummaryRequest.FinalDiagnosis
member.summary: Independently editable from its Create-time prefill (Admission. FinalDiagnosis) — see docs/DecisionLog.md.

member.name: P:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Contracts.UpdateDischargeSummaryRequest.BloodPressure
member.summary: Free-text, e.g. "130/80".

member.name: P:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Contracts.UpdateDischargeSummaryRequest.Medications
member.summary: The full medication list — replaces whatever was there before in one call (list-sync, no separate per-line CRUD). An empty list clears every medication line.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Contracts.FinalizeDischargeSummaryRequest
member.summary: Sign-off captured once, at Finalize — not a multi-step approval workflow (see docs/DecisionLog.md). All three fields are optional: a hospital that only ever fills in "Prepared By" still gets a valid, finalized summary.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Contracts.DischargeSummaryResponse
member.summary: Deliberately carries only this aggregate's own authored content — no live-joined Patient/Admission display fields (name, UHID, ward/bed, consultant, etc.). Per the approved plan, those are fetched separately by the frontend from GET /api/v1/patients/{id} and GET /api/v1/ipd/admissions/{id} at render time, never duplicated here.

member.name: P:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Contracts.DischargeSummaryResponse.FinalDiagnosis
member.summary: Pre-filled from Admission.FinalDiagnosis at Create time, independently editable from that point — see docs/DecisionLog.md.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Contracts.DischargeSummaryStatus
member.summary: Two states only, per the approved plan — the richer Prepared/Checked/Approved sign-off pipeline is captured as a set of optional Guid fields stamped once at Finalize, not as a multi-step workflow with its own states (see DischargeSummaryResponse's sign-off fields).

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Contracts.FoodInstruction
member.summary: Whether a discharge medication line is taken before or after food.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.DischargeSummaryModule
member.summary: Single composition entry point for this module, called once from HMS.Api/Configuration/ModuleRegistration.cs — mirrors every other module's AddXModule.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Domain.DischargeMedication
member.summary: One discharge medication line, always owned by exactly one DischargeSummary — a real, same-schema DB foreign key (unlike AdmissionId/PatientId on the parent, which are cross-module app-level Guids). DrugName is free text, not a Products/Masters catalog reference — Pharmacy has no structured Prescription entity with dose/route/frequency fields to source this from (confirmed at plan time), so this mirrors what's actually printed on a discharge summary. The full list is replaced wholesale on every Update (DischargeSummary.ReplaceMedications) — no separate per-line CRUD endpoints, matching the approved plan's MVP scope.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Domain.DischargeSummary
member.summary: The discharge summary aggregate root for one IPD admission. AdmissionId/PatientId are bare Guids validated at the Application layer through IPD's/Patients' public service interfaces — never a real cross-schema DB foreign key (docs/DatabaseArchitecture.md §7, mirrors HMS.Modules.Pharmacy.Domain.PharmacyStockTransaction's identical treatment of PatientId/AdmissionId). Draft → Finalized is the only state transition; once Finalized, the caller (DischargeSummaryService) is responsible for rejecting further updates — this entity itself does not re-check its own Status before applying a mutation, same convention as HMS.Modules.IPD.Domain.Admission.TransferBed/Discharge.

member.name: P:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Domain.DischargeSummary.FinalDiagnosis
member.summary: Pre-filled from Admission.FinalDiagnosis at time by the caller (DischargeSummaryService) — independently editable from that point via UpdateClinicalDetails, never re-read from Admission after creation.

member.name: P:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Domain.DischargeSummary.CourseInHospital
member.summary: Single narrative field — the structured chronological-event alternative needs richer IPD daily-event data that doesn't exist yet (deferred phase per the approved plan).

member.name: F:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Domain.DischargeSummary._medications
member.summary: 1:many child, real DB FK (unlike AdmissionId/PatientId above) — see DischargeMedication's own doc comment. Only ever loaded/replaced through this aggregate (DischargeSummaryRepository.GetByIdAsync/GetByAdmissionIdAsync both Include this navigation), same pattern as Patient.Allergies/EmergencyContacts.

member.name: M:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Domain.DischargeSummary.Create(System.Guid,System.Guid,System.String,System.Nullable{System.Guid})
member.summary: Caller (DischargeSummaryService) is responsible for confirming the admission is Discharged and that no other DischargeSummary already exists for it before calling this — see docs/DecisionLog.md.

Replaces every clinical/examination/vitals/course/surgical/advice field in one call — the PUT endpoint is a full-record update, not per-field PATCH (matches the approved plan's MVP scope). Caller (DischargeSummaryService) is responsible for rejecting this call while Status isn't Draft — this entity does not re-check its own Status, same convention as and HMS.Modules.IPD.Domain.Admission.TransferBed/Discharge. Free-text fields are trimmed and normalized to null when blank, so "cleared" and "never entered" read identically.

member.name: M:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Domain.DischargeSummary.ReplaceMedications(System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable{HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Domain.DischargeMedication},System.Nullable{System.Guid})
member.summary: Fully replaces the medication list — delete-then-reinsert list-sync, no separate per-line CRUD endpoints (matches the approved plan's MVP scope). Caller (DischargeSummaryService) constructs each new DischargeMedication via DischargeMedication.Create beforehand, already carrying this aggregate's Id and the intended SortOrder. Caller is responsible for rejecting this call while Status isn't Draft, same convention as UpdateClinicalDetails.

member.name: M:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Domain.DischargeSummary.Finalize(System.Nullable{System.Guid},System.Nullable{System.Guid},System.Nullable{System.Guid},System.DateTime,System.Nullable{System.Guid})
member.summary: Caller (DischargeSummaryService) is responsible for rejecting this call while already Finalized.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Endpoints.DischargeSummariesController
member.summary: Base route is api/v1/discharge-summaries, but Create/GetByAdmission deliberately live under api/v1/admissions/{admissionId}/discharge-summary instead (absolute route overrides, per the approved plan's API section) — a discharge summary is always reached starting from a specific admission for those two actions.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Infrastructure.Configurations.DischargeMedicationConfiguration
member.summary: Maps to discharge_summary.discharge_medications. Internal (not public) for the same CS0051 reason as DischargeSummaryConfiguration — the entity is an internal domain type.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Infrastructure.Configurations.DischargeSummaryConfiguration
member.summary: Maps to discharge_summary.discharge_summaries, following the naming/PK/audit-column/soft-delete standards in docs/DatabaseArchitecture.md. Internal (not public): the entity is an internal domain type, so a public Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<DischargeSummary>) member would be a CS0051 accessibility violation. EF Core's ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly discovers and invokes this via reflection regardless of the type's own visibility, so internal is sufficient here.

member.name: T:HMS.Modules.DischargeSummary.Infrastructure.DischargeSummaryDbContext
member.summary: Owns the "discharge_summary" PostgreSQL schema. Per docs/DatabaseArchitecture.md §1, only this module's own code constructs/migrates this context — no other module references it.
